title: A browser release leaves an agent's page size on the person's tab
notes: browserRelease (src/main/actions/browser/claims.ts) and letGo (browser-actions.ts) hand a tab back without clearing the Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride that browser resize set. An agent resizes a tab to 390x844 and then releases it, and the person's tab stays drawn 390 wide in the full view. Nothing on screen clears it. Fix: release and letGo clear a size an agent set (emulate(tab, null)). Issue: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/issues/361 Review: https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/360#discussion_r4685057302
